junior-daily.angle: Where in the world and who is involved: follow the two American envoys through one day, from the Kremlin in Moscow to an airfield in Dublin, and meet who was waiting for them in each city.

breakfast-table.angle: What it means at home: why go-betweens carry messages when two sides will not sit together, why Europe's leaders want a chair at the table, and what families can take from talks that continue without a result yet.
